ev.q: During 2013–2015, mortality rates among AI/AN were 2.7 and 4.1 times higher than rates among whites
age-adjusted total drug, opioid-involved, and heroin-involved overdose mortality rates (per 100,000 population)
During 2013–2015, 184 drug overdose deaths occurred among AI/AN in Washington, including 126 (68.5%) that involved opioids.
subsequent overdose rates among AI/AN increased at a faster rate than did those among whites
Age-specific drug overdose mortality rates among AI/AN were almost twice those among whites.
Washington drug overdose deaths were identified using death certificate statistical files for 1999–2015
Trends were calculated as 3-year rolling averages of age-adjusted mortality rates during the period 1999–2015.
Death certificates were corrected for misclassification of AI/AN race by conducting probabilistic record linkages

methods_quotes.q: Trends were calculated as 3-year rolling averages of age-adjusted mortality rates during the period 1999–2015.
For rates among AI/AN, 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were based on the gamma distribution to account for small cell sizes
Rates were age-adjusted to the U.S. 2000 standard population
Two staff members conducted clerical review of all potential matched pairs to identify true matches.
Uncorrected national and state-level estimates for 2013–2015 were obtained from the CDC WONDER Online Database for comparison.
